name: TCH (DOCEtaxel / CARBOplatin / Trastuzumab)
histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

biomarkers.note: HER2-directed regimen: requires HER2-positive disease (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified). HR (ER/PR) status is tested to guide the addition of endocrine therapy, not the HER2 backbone. Anthracycline-free HER2 regimen (no doxorubicin), historically preferred where cardiac risk is a concern (BCIRG-006). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer, Preoperative/Adjuvant Therapy (BINV-M).

lineOfTherapy: adjuvant or neoadjuvant HER2-directed chemotherapy for early-stage HER2-positive breast cancer; not line-scoped

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: adequate left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF); evaluate LVEF before and during HER2-targeted therapy
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v6.2026, BINV-M 1 of 10, For Those Receiving HER2-Targeted Therapy

drugs.name: DOCEtaxel
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. DOCEtaxel 75 mg/m2 IV day 1, cycled every 21 days for 6 cycles. Tall-man per ISMP.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. CARBOplatin AUC 6 IV day 1 (Calvert-formula target AUC, not mg/m2), cycled every 21 days for 6 cycles. Tall-man per ISMP.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (loading, weekly schedule)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. Trastuzumab 4 mg/kg IV week 1 (loading dose, weekly schedule).

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (weekly maintenance)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. Trastuzumab 2 mg/kg IV weekly for 17 weeks, following the loading dose.

drugs.name: Trastuzumab (every-3-week maintenance)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10. Trastuzumab 6 mg/kg IV cycled every 21 days to complete 1 year of therapy. Alternative all-every-3-week schedule (source-stated): Trastuzumab 8 mg/kg IV week 1 (loading) followed by 6 mg/kg IV every 21 days to complete 1 year.

premedications.name: DOCEtaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid premedication per docetaxel labeling; give before docetaxel. Confirm exact schedule against institutional order set.

supportiveCare: G-CSF / myeloid growth factor support: all cycles are given with myeloid growth factor support per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-M dosing footnote n.
Antiemetics: DOCEtaxel plus CARBOplatin combination; provide prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier (verify exact NCCN antiemesis tier).
Cardiac: evaluate LVEF before and during trastuzumab (FDA label recommends LVEF prior to initiation and every 3 months during therapy) per BINV-M 1 of 10.

monitoring: LVEF at baseline and periodically during trastuzumab (every 3 months per FDA label / BINV-M 1 of 10)

doseModificationRules.condition: significant decline in LVEF or symptomatic heart failure
doseModificationRules.text: Hold trastuzumab and obtain clinical review per LVEF monitoring guidance (BINV-M 1 of 10). Physician decides on continuation.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: lines 22102 to 22107 (HER2/ERBB2-amplified breast cancer therapy options: trastuzumab, trastuzumab + chemo, trastuzumab + pertuzumab + chemo, T-DM1, T-DXd)

guideline.locator: Dosing: Preoperative/Adjuvant Therapy Regimens, HER2-Positive, TCH (DOCEtaxel/CARBOplatin + Trastuzumab), BINV-M 7 of 10; setting/eligibility BINV-M 3 of 10 and BINV-M 1 of 10

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the breast HER2-directed regimen TCH. Serves subtype #4 (HER2-positive), histology-agnostic across invasive ductal (#1) and invasive lobular (#2) carcinoma. DeVita 12th ed. names the HER2-positive breast regimen framework (lines 22102 to 22107) but does not tabulate per-drug doses for TCH; therefore every numeric dose here is sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer v6.2026, BINV-M 7 of 10, with locators recorded per drug. DOCEtaxel 75 mg/m2 and CARBOplatin AUC 6 on day 1, every 21 days for 6 cycles; trastuzumab 4 mg/kg loading then 2 mg/kg weekly for 17 weeks then 6 mg/kg every 21 days to complete 1 year (alternative all-every-3-week schedule 8 mg/kg loading then 6 mg/kg every 21 days is source-stated). ISMP tall-man applied (DOCEtaxel, CARBOplatin). CARBOplatin dosed by target AUC (basis auc, unit AUC). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
